title: ticks' worker.sh must consume TICKS_ROLE_PROMPT so a cloud worker runs on the profile's prompt
body: ticfac's sandbox dispatch door now delivers the profile's rendered role prompt into the worker container's boot environment as TICKS_ROLE_PROMPT (tick 9iz), but image/worker.sh (authored in ticks, vendored here under the sandbox pin) still builds the harness's prompt only from `tk sandbox worker-prompt` in the checkout, so the delivered prompt is dead-lettered in an environment variable. The same ticks-side change should reconcile the two report contracts the door's prompt introduces: the profile prompt names runs/<run>/<tick>/RESULT-<tick>.md (git-excluded) while worker.sh guarantees RESULT-<tick>.md at the branch root, and an agent following the profile prompt today would write its report where worker.sh cannot commit it. Until this lands, a cloud epic run still boots workers on the checkout's prompt, which is what tick 9iz's gate (u9h) needs closed.
